_rascunho: Draft translation of the Portuguese text (pt.json is the final one).
chamada: Show your trusted circle where you are, ask for help and set a walk-home timer. Your location leaves this device end-to-end encrypted: not even the people who run Alumia can see it.
limite: Works only while Alumia is open on this device. People only see your latest location while you share. No trail is kept.

circulo.texto: Your safety contacts from protest mode who accepted. Each one receives through the encrypted chat you already share.
circulo.vazio: You don't have a safety contact who accepted yet.
circulo.pedido: Chat request sent. Once accepted, they will receive.

compartilhar.texto: For a limited time. When it ends, or when you stop, the location disappears from the receivers' devices.
compartilhar.confirmar: Share your location with {n} person(s) in your circle?
compartilhar.ligadoParar: Sharing with {n} person(s) until you stop.
compartilhar.naoSaiu: The last update did not go out. Alumia will try again.
compartilhar.umaVez: Send where I am now, just once
compartilhar.umaVezConfirmar: Send your current location just once to {n} person(s) in your circle? It disappears from their device in 1 hour.
compartilhar.umaVezFeito: Location sent to {n} person(s). It disappears in 1 hour.
compartilhar.faixa: You are sharing your location with {n} person(s) in your circle until {hora}.
compartilhar.faixaParar: You are sharing your location with {n} person(s) in your circle until you stop.

recebidas.vazio: Nobody is sharing with you right now.
recebidas.abrirNoAparelho: Open in the device's map app
recebidas.semPosicao: No location: their device could not get it.

sos.texto: Sends “I need help” and your exact location, encrypted, to everyone in your circle who can receive now.
sos.confirmar: Send the help request, with your exact location, to {n} person(s)?
sos.enviadoSemPosicao: Help request sent to {n} person(s), without location: the device could not get it.
sos.ninguem: Nobody in your circle can receive right now. Open a chat with them first.

volta.texto: Set how long it takes. If you don't tap “I'm home” by then, this device sends the help request to your circle. The timer stays only here: the server doesn't know.
volta.ultimo: The walk-home time is over. If you don't answer, the help request goes out in {tempo}.
volta.saiu: The help request went out to your circle.
volta.limite: Works only while Alumia is open on this device (or opened again after the deadline).

naConversa.sosVolta: Help request: walk home not confirmed

pedido.confirmar: Ask @{nome} for their location? It arrives as a request: they accept or decline.
pedido.enviado: Request sent. You only receive it if they accept.
pedido.chegou: {nome} asked to see where you are
pedido.aceito: You are sharing your location with this person.

canal.texto: Get a bell notification when the organization posts. Nobody sees who subscribed, not even the organization.
canal.menosDe3: Fewer than 3 people receive this organization's notices.

sala.senhaAjuda: Anyone without the password lands in an empty room. The password never leaves this device.
sala.limite: Room messages are encrypted but not yet signed: someone in the group could pretend to be the host.
sala.ouvindo: You are listening. Raise your hand to ask to speak.
sala.esperando: Waiting for the host to let you in.
sala.presencaPoucas: Fewer than 3 people in the room

erros.sem_local: The device did not provide a location. Check the location permission.
erros.sem_circulo: Nobody in your circle can receive right now.
erros.nao_saiu: It didn't reach anyone. Try again.
erros.dm_sem_chave: Turn on the encrypted chat on this device first.
erros.desligado: This is not turned on yet.
erros.sem_contatos: You don't have a safety contact who accepted yet.
erros.sem_permissao: Only the organization's managers see this.
